title: 安全设计审查
scope: Threat models, trust boundaries, authorization, secret handling and evidence-based security review.
routingDescription: Threat models, trust boundaries, authorization, secret handling and evidence-based security review.
useWhen: Assess an exposed secret or claimed vulnerability

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use architecture when state or data evolution is the dominant decision.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify assets, attacker capabilities, trust boundaries and allowed assessment scope.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Tie each concern to a concrete threat and reachable surface.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When identifiers or tenant labels are supplied
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check server-side authentication, per-object authorization and scope propagation.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Do not treat classification labels or hidden UI controls as an ownership check.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Trace collection, storage, forwarding, logs and rotation without requesting secret values.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Prefer scoped credentials and name each place exposure could occur.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Separate demonstrated behavior from a suspected issue and describe prerequisites and impact.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Assign severity from supported exploitability and consequence.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Specify how the control is checked at the trust boundary and how regression would be detected.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Give a bounded correction and a verification plan rather than a compliance claim.

evidenceRequirements: Sanitized request/response or code path supporting a finding
qualityChecks: No compliance or security certification without evidence
riskRules: Active probing and incident actions require separately authorized scope; private credentials are never necessary context

preferredSources: The actual system's authorization design and scoped threat model
refreshTriggers: Current advisories for a named affected software version
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: A task API accepts a project label and lets any bearer download another task artifact.
examples.expected: Check per-object authorization independently of the project label.
examples.reject: Conclude the project label enforces tenant isolation.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
